thread:
incbot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Elevated token accounting observed for tenant Helios in dedicated-pool-11 (VPC). Tokenization counts ~4-5x baseline for /v1/chat/completions. Suspected client-side encoding change or tokenizer mismatch. Auto-notify to oncall.

oncall-sre: Acknowledged. Alert start ~1839002200. Any user-facing errors or throttles reported?

dev_nate: Pulling runtime traces. I see lots of requests with identical payload length but wildly different reported_tokens. Example: see below.

ops_kate: log snippet:

```
2025-10-18T14:02:11Z req=0a1b tenant=helios model=gptx-1 input_len_bytes=1024 reported_tokens=520 tokenizer=cl100k-v1
2025-10-18T14:02:12Z req=0a1c tenant=helios model=gptx-1 input_len_bytes=1024 reported_tokens=2430 tokenizer=bpe-legacy
2025-10-18T14:02:12Z req=0a1d tenant=helios model=gptx-1 input_len_bytes=1024 reported_tokens=496 tokenizer=cl100k-v1
```

dev_nate: Notice the middle line — same bytes but tokenized differently. Correlating headers, some client requests include Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-16 or contain a UTF-16 BOM. Our detector sometimes picks bpe-legacy when BOM present.

cs_zhang: I contacted the Helios engineering lead. They confirmed they rolled a new analytics agent this morning that may change serialization. They're onboard with us doing non-disruptive mitigations.

pm_lena: This is an enterprise VPC. Avoid customer-wide rollbacks. Use tenant-scoped controls. Also coordinate with security to ensure header injection doesn't bypass controls.

security_lee: Noted. Any header-based change must be tenant-scoped and audited. We'll ask for an allowlist entry and log the change.

oncall-sre: Proposed immediate steps (tenant-scoped, non-disruptive):
1) Pause billing enforcement for tenant:helios (soft mode) to prevent automated enforcement actions.
2) Apply a temporary per-tenant spending cap at 3x baseline.
3) Inject X-Redwood-Tokenizer: cl100k-v1 at ingress for tenant hel-*** to force canonical tokenization.
4) Open eng-runtime ticket to prefer tenant-pinned tokenizer over auto-detect.

billing_ron: If we pause enforcement, set a provisional credit flag to avoid invoicing. I'll calculate provisional credit estimate once we lock the window.

ops_kate: I can add an ingress rule scoped to tenant ID hel-42 to append header X-Redwood-Tokenizer: cl100k-v1. Will canary to two nodes first.

incbot: ACTION: oncall-sre assigned. INCIDENT PRIORITY: P2.

oncall-sre: Canary in progress on edge-1 and edge-2.

ops_kate: Canary done. Rolling to edge-3 and edge-4.

runtime_maya: Quick check of runtime: it honors X-Redwood-Tokenizer header per tenant if header present. Good target for quick mitigation.

oncall-sre: Rate limit update: set tenant_token_cap=3x-baseline, burst=1.25x. This will limit immediate spend while keeping requests successful.

billing_ron: Created provisional credit hold, estimated at $8,300 for the affected window. Flagged invoices to exclude this tenant until RCA.

cs_zhang: Sending customer note to Helios: "We detected abnormal token counts after your analytics agent update. We've applied tenant-scoped protections (rate cap) and temporarily suspended billing enforcement while we investigate. No service interruption expected. We'll update in one hour and follow up with RCA."

pm_lena: Add expected timeline and offer to share logs and token diff report in the postmortem.

ops_kate: Full header rollout completed on all ingress nodes. Verifying downstream runtime sees header.

dev_nate: Observed token median return to baseline within ~3 minutes of header enforcement. See quick metric: median tokens/request before override 1320, after override 540, baseline 510.

runtime_maya: Root cause hypothesis: auto-detect path misclassifies when utf-16 BOM present, falling back to legacy bpe matching older code paths. Fix: skip auto-detect when tenant has pinned tokenizer; make detector BOM-aware. I'll open a PR for a hotfix.

security_lee: Confirmed ingress header changes logged and an allowlist entry created for tenant hel-42. Audit trail saved to secure logs.

oncall-sre: Next action items:
- runtime_maya: hotfix to prefer tenant-pinned tokenizer and improve BOM handling (PR + test)
- ops_kate: keep ingress header rule until hotfix deployed and validated
- billing_ron: finalize provisional credit and prepare customer compensation plan
- cs_zhang & pm_lena: customer comms and approval for compensation

billing_ron: I've held off posting credits to billing ledger and set provisional flag. Will not push to billing system until postmortem confirms scope.

pm_lena: Please ensure customer-facing language clarifies we took non-disruptive action and are preserving their integrations.

runtime_maya: PR opened: runtime#4821 — guard to prefer tenant.pinned_tokenizer and unit tests for UTF-16 BOM + charset header. Linking in thread soon.

ops_kate: Monitoring: token counts steady, spending delta decelerating.

oncall-sre: Handing to next-shift oncall for 12h observation. Create a follow-up task to verify hotfix in staging and then prod deploy.

incbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: tenant-scoped mitigation applied and verified. Moving to MONITORING.

dev_nate: Note for postmortem: add runbook step to detect rapid tokenizer-label churn per tenant and trigger automated tenant-scoped overrides. Also add synthetic tests for multi-byte charsets.

cs_zhang: Helios replied: "Thanks, this matches our change. We'll coordinate with our vendor to pin serializer behavior. Appreciate the quick response"

security_lee: Reminder: any future header injections must include TTL and automatic removal after incident. Ops please add a removal schedule.

billing_ron: Final provisional credit estimate will be updated after 24h monitoring.

incbot: INCIDENT MOVED TO MONITORING. Close when RCA and compensation documented.
